features.title: Everything has its place.
features.description: Caisse, orders, invoices, inventory, customers, purchases and reports—all your team’s tools in one place.
items: Dashboard & analytics
Date filters, revenue trends, category sales, payment status, expenses and low-stock indicators.
Products & pricing
Product images, SKU, barcode, purchase cost, three selling prices and minimum stock levels.
Categories & brands
Organize your catalogue by category and brand to find products more easily.
Product import
Import product records from Excel with field validation and row-level error feedback.
Orders
Create customer orders, update items and prices, follow statuses and generate invoices.
Caisse / POS
Find products by barcode, adjust the cart, select customers, hold sales, record payments and print invoices.
Inventory & low stock
Check quantities and stock alerts, record stock IN, OUT and manual adjustments.
Stock movement history
Trace movements associated with sales, purchases, returns and manual adjustments.
Invoices & payments
Create invoices, print or download PDFs, record payments and review payment history.
Customer accounts
Manage contact details, favourites, outstanding balances and balance adjustments.
Customer statements
Review customer transactions and product details using statement filters, tables and charts.
Suppliers
Maintain supplier accounts, product and purchase history, balances and supplier payments.
Purchases & receiving
Create purchase orders, edit items, attach documents, record payments and receive stock.
AI invoice scanner
Upload a PDF or image, extract invoice lines, review product matches and confirm a purchase.
Sales returns
Return invoice items, record their condition, track refunds or customer credit and stock movements.
Purchase returns
Return products to suppliers and record refund amounts, supplier credit and stock movements.
Expenses
Record rent, salaries, transport, utilities and other expenses with dates and descriptions.
Reports & exports
Explore order, product, customer, supplier, purchase and inventory reports; export CSV, Excel or PDF, or print.
Users & permissions
Manage staff accounts, reset passwords and assign roles with permissions for each module.
Languages & appearance
Work in Arabic, French or English, with customizable app naming, logo and light/dark theme colours.

faq.title: Good questions. Clear answers.
faq.description: Built around how the platform actually works.
items: How does inventory update after a sale?
Recording a sale through an invoice or the POS updates product quantities and records the corresponding inventory movement. You can review movement history in the inventory workspace.
Can I manage suppliers and purchases?
Yes. You can create supplier records and purchase orders, record supplier payments, attach purchase documents and receive purchased products into stock.
Can I control what each employee can access?
Yes. Staff have individual accounts with assigned roles. Roles grant permissions for viewing or managing business modules, and permission checks are enforced on the server.
How does AI invoice scanning work?

Upload a supplier invoice as a PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP image. The scanner extracts fields and suggests product matches. Review the extracted quantities, prices and matches, resolve missing information, then confirm the purchase. AI output needs human review.
Can I manage returns?
Yes. The application includes sales returns and purchase returns, with item conditions, refund tracking and corresponding stock movements.
What reports are available?
Reports cover orders, products, customers, suppliers, purchases and inventory. Dashboard analytics include sales trends, category sales, payment status and expenses.
Can I use the system on a phone or tablet?
The application has responsive layouts for smaller screens. Larger screens give detailed tables, reports and the cashier workspace more room.
